description: This file defines a class 'tuleap' providing a PHP API client for interacting with Tuleap's REST API, including methods for authentication, fetching artifacts and trackers, and updating artifacts.

classes.name: tuleap
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a lightweight API client for Tuleap, supporting authentication, fetching artifacts and trackers, and modifying artifacts via REST API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tuleap API object with URL, username, and password.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL session with specific options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Authenticates with Tuleap API by obtaining a token and user id.

methods.name: getArtifactById
methods.description: Fetches an artifact based on its ID.

methods.name: getTrackerById
methods.description: Fetches tracker definition based on its ID.

methods.name: _getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request and returns JSON-decoded response.

methods.name: _putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with JSON data.

methods.name: addTrackerArtifactMessage
methods.description: Adds a comment/message to a tracker artifact.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new tracker artifact (issue) with given tracker ID, summary, and description.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON data.
